# Template Router: task → template, for every agent

> Button (= the result): **The right template, every time, without asking.** Source: Sasha, 2026-11-03 («чтобы ты шаблоны ловко использовал, без того чтобы я говорил каждый раз»); named a load-bearing module 2026-11-19. Template: meta-template.

## Meta-description
- **Level / parent:** L1 · Ops & Agents · parent: [meta-template.md](./meta-template.md)
- **Lens:** Ideal Forms (one canonical form per kind of work) with Causal (task → form → result)
- **Shift carried:** **before:** every agent (Hark, Claude Code, Codex) re-invents the form of each artifact, and Sasha repeats "use the template" by hand · **after:** any agent maps the task to its template before the first word and names it in the report · **check:** each report, PR or issue names the template it followed (one line "Template: …"); Sasha never has to ask for it
- **What emerges:** artifacts of one shape across all agents; every lesson lands in one template and reaches every future use
- **As a part of the whole:** the load-bearing joint of the architecture. Templates are the MODULE layer (methodology); the router is the `//` that connects any task to its module, so the methodology reaches the PROMPT layer (agents) without Sasha in the loop
- **Siblings:** [README.md](./README.md) (full inventory, source of truth for what exists), [holonic-prism.md](./holonic-prism.md) (the prism every template stands on), `CLAUDE.md` §Templates first, Hark specialty `templates-first` (points to this file)
- **Status · last reviewed:** v1.1 · 2026-11-19 (Result column added)

## Through the prism
- **Essence:** a switch between "what is asked" and "the form that already knows how to do it".
- **Significance:** Sasha's method stops living in his head and in chat; it lives in forms any agent picks up by itself.
- **Consequences:** agents produce at his level without supervision; every improvement to one template upgrades every future artifact of that kind.
- **One sentence:** The router makes every agent build with Sasha's forms by default, so his method scales without him repeating it.

## Rule
1. Before producing anything, find the task in the table below and open that template from `main`. Do not ask Sasha which one.
2. Follow it. In the report, PR or issue, name it in one line ("Template: shift-offer").
3. No row fits: do the work; if the shape repeats, propose a new template (extend an existing one first, never multiply docs) via [meta-template.md](./meta-template.md).
4. A new template is not live until it has a row here (with its Result) and in [README.md](./README.md).
5. The Result column follows the button law: a button's label IS the transformational result it delivers. The same line is that template's button on the Controller (AI OS).
